arStrings.szText: "Why look for this weapon? Why don't we just kill Mephisto?"
Neyrelle thinks it's a more lasting solution. In her letter, she said it would “break the cycle.”
Somber, given the situation, but using his knowledge to answer the Player.
I don’t know what she meant exactly, but I do know that killing Mephisto would only send him back to Hell to be reborn again.
Somber, given the situation, but using his knowledge to answer the Player.
If this weapon can do more than that...we can only hope it’s better than a soulstone.
Somber, given the situation, but using his knowledge to answer the Player. He doesn't want to get his hopes up too high though.
